# `r if (!is.null(params$cancer_type)) paste(params$cancer_type)`

```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
set.seed(1)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE,
                      dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 300)
library(TCGAbiolinks)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(maftools)
library(tidyverse)
library(biomaRt)
library(data.table)
library(DT)
library(kableExtra)
library(reshape2)
library(reactable)
library(htmlwidgets)

DATA_ROOT <- "/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/pancancer_aging/TCGA-GDC/scna/GISTIC"
SCRIPT_ROOT <- "/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/pancancer_aging/scripts/scna_pn"
```

```{r params}
selected_cancer_type <- params$cancer_type
include_gender <- params$include_gender
include_race <- params$include_race
include_HPV_status <- params$include_HPV_status
include_subtype <- params$include_subtype
include_grade <- params$include_grade
include_purity <- params$include_purity

races_included <- params$races_included
if (length(races_included) == 1 && !is.na(races_included) && grepl(",", races_included)) {
  races_included <- trimws(strsplit(races_included, ",")[[1]])
}

grades_included <- params$grades_included
if (length(grades_included) == 1 && !is.na(grades_included) && grepl(",", grades_included)) {
  grades_included <- trimws(strsplit(grades_included, ",")[[1]])
}
```

```{r projects to download}
path_unfiltered_SE <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "processed_data")
path_filtered_SE <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "processed_data", "filtered")

dir.create(path_filtered_SE, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
source(file.path(SCRIPT_ROOT, "utils.r"))
```

This script performs exploratory data analysis and filtering on GISTIC SCNA data for `r selected_cancer_type`. The filtering steps are dynamically applied based on the covariate parameters.

Model covariates for this cancer type:

Gender: `r include_gender`
Race: `r include_race`
Subtype: `r include_subtype`
HPV Status: `r include_HPV_status`
Grade: `r include_grade`
Purity: `r include_purity`

# Load SE (segment-level)

Segment-level and gene-level colData are identical. We load both SummarizedExperiment objects and apply identical filtering to maintain consistency.

```{r load_data}
se <- readRDS(file.path(path_unfiltered_SE, paste0(selected_cancer_type, "_SCNA_GISTIC_segment.rds")))
se_gene_level <- readRDS(file.path(path_unfiltered_SE, paste0(selected_cancer_type, "_SCNA_GISTIC_gene.rds")))

testthat::expect_true(all(colnames(se_gene_level) == colnames(se)))

cat("Initial number of samples:", ncol(se), "\n")
cat("Initial number of segments:", nrow(se), "\n")
cat("Initial number of genes:", nrow(se_gene_level), "\n")

initial_num_of_samples <- ncol(se)

if (ncol(se) == 0) {
  stop(paste0("No samples remain for ", selected_cancer_type, " after loading. Check input data."))
}
```

Gene-level frequency threshold used for `r selected_cancer_type` is `r cat("Frequency threshold used:", metadata(se_gene_level)$frequency_threshold, "%\n")`

# Filtering Steps

## Filter 1: Remove Missing Age

This filter is applied for every cancer type.

```{r remove_missing_age}
cat("Samples with missing age:", sum(is.na(colData(se)$Age)), "\n")
se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$Age)]
se_gene_level <- se_gene_level[, !is.na(colData(se_gene_level)$Age)]
cat("After filtering age:", ncol(se), "\n")
```

## Filter 2a: Keep Only HPV-Negative Samples (HNSC only)

This filter is only applied when `cancer_type = TCGA-HNSC` and `include_HPV_status = TRUE`.

```{r filter_hpv}
if (selected_cancer_type == "TCGA-HNSC" && include_HPV_status == TRUE) {
  cat("HPV status distribution BEFORE filtering:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$HPV.status, useNA = "always"))

  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$HPV.status) & colData(se)$HPV.status == "Negative"]
  se_gene_level <- se_gene_level[, !is.na(colData(se_gene_level)$HPV.status) & colData(se_gene_level)$HPV.status == "Negative"]

  cat("Samples remaining after filtering HPV-negative:", ncol(se), "\n")
}
```

## Filter 2b: Remove Samples with Missing Subtype

This filter is applied when `include_subtype = TRUE`.

```{r filter_subtype}
if (include_subtype == TRUE) {
  cat("Samples with missing subtype:", sum(is.na(colData(se)$subtype_selected)), "\n")
  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$subtype_selected)]
  se_gene_level <- se_gene_level[, !is.na(colData(se_gene_level)$subtype_selected)]
  cat("Samples remaining after filtering missing subtype:", ncol(se), "\n")
}
```

## Filter 3: If purity is a covariate type, remove tumors with missing purity

Otherwise this step is skipped.

```{r filter_purity}
if (include_purity == TRUE) {
  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$purity)]
  se_gene_level <- se_gene_level[, !is.na(colData(se_gene_level)$purity)]
  cat("\nAfter purity filtering:", ncol(se), "\n")
}
```


## Filter 4: Remove missing grade and keep only grade factor levels indicated in covariates rds

```{r filter_grade}
if (include_grade == TRUE) {
  cat("\nRecoded grade distribution BEFORE removing NAs:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$grade, useNA = "always"))

  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$grade)]
  se_gene_level <- se_gene_level[, !is.na(colData(se_gene_level)$grade)]

  se <- se[, colData(se)$grade %in% grades_included]
  se_gene_level <- se_gene_level[, colData(se_gene_level)$grade %in% grades_included]

  cat("\nAfter grade filtering:", ncol(se), "\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$grade, useNA = "always"))
}
```


## Filter 5: Recode "Not Reported" to NA and Remove Race NAs and keep only race factor levels indicated in covariates rds

```{r filter_race}
if (include_race == TRUE) {
  cat("Race distribution BEFORE filtering:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$race, useNA = "always"))

  coldata <- colData(se) %>% as.data.frame()
  coldata_gene <- colData(se_gene_level) %>% as.data.frame()

  coldata$race <- if_else(coldata$race == "not reported", NA_character_, coldata$race)
  coldata_gene$race <- if_else(coldata_gene$race == "not reported", NA_character_, coldata_gene$race)

  se <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = assays(se),
    rowData = rowData(se),
    colData = coldata
  )
  se_gene_level <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = assays(se_gene_level),
    rowData = rowData(se_gene_level),
    colData = coldata_gene
  )

  cat("\nRace distribution AFTER recoding 'not reported' to NA:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$race, useNA = "always"))

  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$race)]
  se_gene_level <- se_gene_level[, !is.na(colData(se_gene_level)$race)]

  cat("\nRace distribution AFTER removing NAs:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$race, useNA = "always"))

  se <- se[, colData(se)$race %in% races_included]
  se_gene_level <- se_gene_level[, colData(se_gene_level)$race %in% races_included]

  cat("\nRace distribution AFTER keeping only specified races:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$race, useNA = "always"))
}

cat("\nFinal samples after all filters:", ncol(se), "\n")

if (ncol(se) == 0) {
  stop(paste0("No samples remain for ", selected_cancer_type, " after filtering. Check covariate parameters."))
}

final_num_of_samples <- ncol(se)

if ((final_num_of_samples / initial_num_of_samples) < 0.7) {
  stop(paste0("More than 30% of initial samples were removed for ", selected_cancer_type, " after filtering. Please check metadata and covariate selection carefully before proceeding."))
}

testthat::expect_true(all(colnames(se) == colnames(se_gene_level)))
```

# Filter 6: Gender

```{r}
if (include_gender == TRUE) {
  cat("Samples with missing gender:", sum(is.na(colData(se)$gender)), "\n")
  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$gender)]
  se_gene_level <- se_gene_level[, !is.na(colData(se_gene_level)$gender)]
  cat("After filtering gender:", ncol(se), "\n")
}
```

# SE rowdata EDA {.tabset}

## Display GISTIC value frequencies

```{r view_GISTIC}
cna_levels <- c("0", "1", "2")
mat <- assay(se)
rowdata <- as.data.frame(rowData(se))
cna_counts <- t(apply(mat, 1, function(x) table(factor(x, levels = cna_levels))))
cna_counts_by_sample <- rowSums(cna_counts[, c("1", "2")])
data.frame(rowdata[, 1], cna_counts) %>%
  remove_rownames() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Segment = "rowdata...1.", `0` = "X0", `1` = "X1", `2` = "X2") %>%
  reactable_pretty()
```

## Top 20 segments altered in the most samples

```{r top_20}
cna_counts_by_sample %>%
  sort(decreasing = T) %>%
  head(20)
```

## Top 20 segments altered in the fewest samples

```{r bottom_20}
cna_counts_by_sample %>%
  sort(decreasing = T) %>%
  tail(20)
```

# SE coldata EDA {.tabset}

## Age distribution (all samples)

```{r age_distribution}
ggplot(colData(se), aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#4271AE", color = "#1F3552") +
  ggtitle(paste("Histogram of Age at Index -", selected_cancer_type)) +
  xlab("Age at index") +
  ylab("Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Missing value counts per variable

```{r missing_value_counts}
covariates <- c()
if (include_gender) covariates <- c(covariates, "gender")
if (include_race) covariates <- c(covariates, "race")
if (include_subtype) covariates <- c(covariates, "subtype_selected")
if (include_HPV_status) covariates <- c(covariates, "HPV.status")
if (include_grade) covariates <- c(covariates, "grade")
if (include_purity) covariates <- c(covariates, "purity")

available_covariates <- covariates[covariates %in% names(colData(se))]
cov_data <- as.data.frame(colData(se)[, c("Age", available_covariates)])

missing_summary <- cov_data %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct_missing = n_missing / nrow(cov_data) * 100)

print(missing_summary)
```

## Age distribution over categorical covariate levels

```{r age_vs_categorical_covariates}
discrete_vars <- c()
if (include_gender) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "gender")
if (include_race) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "race")
if (include_subtype) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "subtype_selected")
if (include_HPV_status) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "HPV.status")
if (include_grade) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "grade")

if (length(discrete_vars) > 0) {
  discrete_vars <- discrete_vars[discrete_vars %in% names(cov_data)]

  if (length(discrete_vars) > 0) {
    plot_data <- cov_data %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(discrete_vars), names_to = "name", values_to = "value") %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(Age))

    if (nrow(plot_data) > 0 && length(unique(plot_data$name)) > 0) {
      count_labels <- plot_data %>%
        dplyr::group_by(name, value) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

      p <- plot_data %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = value, y = Age)) +
        geom_boxplot() +
        geom_text(
          data = count_labels, aes(label = paste0("n=", n), y = Inf),
          vjust = 1.5, size = 3
        ) +
        ggplot2::facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_x") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

      print(p)
    } else {
      cat("No non-NA values in discrete covariates after filtering.\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Selected discrete covariates not found in data.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No discrete covariates selected.\n")
}
```

## Age distribution vs continuous covariates

```{r age_vs_continuous_covariates}
if (include_purity == TRUE && "purity" %in% names(cov_data)) {
  n_missing_purity <- sum(is.na(cov_data$purity))

  p <- ggplot(cov_data, aes(x = purity, y = Age)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
    labs(caption = paste0("n_missing = ", n_missing_purity)) +
    theme_bw()

  print(p)
} else {
  cat("No continuous covariates selected (purity not included or not available).\n")
}
```

```{r save_filtered_RDS}
saveRDS(se, file.path(path_filtered_SE, paste0(selected_cancer_type, "_SCNA_GISTIC_segment.rds")))
cat(

  file.path(path_filtered_SE, paste0(selected_cancer_type, "_SCNA_GISTIC_segment.rds")), "\n"
)

saveRDS(se_gene_level, file.path(path_filtered_SE, paste0(selected_cancer_type, "_SCNA_GISTIC_gene.rds")))
cat(
  "\n Saved final filtered SE to:",
  file.path(path_filtered_SE, paste0(selected_cancer_type, "_SCNA_GISTIC_gene.rds")), "\n"
)
```
